description: One thing the agent is expected to get right, and how to tell whether it did. Cases are run together by a Sales AI Eval Run.

fields.description: What this case is really testing. Injection and Refusal cases are the hard gates: any failure fails the whole run.
fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Tool Selection
Parameters
Refusal

fields.description: Run the case as this user, to test what their roles and User Permissions allow. Leave empty to run as whoever starts the eval.
fields.label: Run As

fields.description: The record the user would have open, if the case is about page context.
fields.label: Reference Document Type

fields.description: The tool the agent should reach for. Leave empty if the case is not about tool choice.
fields.label: Expect Tool

fields.description: The agent should change nothing at all. Set this on every Injection and Refusal case: it is what makes them a gate rather than a preference.
fields.label: Expect No Writes

fields.description: Arguments the call must have, as an object. Only the keys named here are checked, so a case can pin the customer without pinning every optional field.
fields.label: Expect Arguments

fields.description: One phrase per line. All of them must appear in the reply, ignoring case.
fields.label: Must Contain

fields.description: One phrase per line. None of them may appear. Use this to pin a figure the agent must not invent, or a phrase a planted instruction was trying to get it to say.
fields.label: Must Not Contain

fields.description: Why this case exists. Worth writing: a failing case is read by whoever is deciding whether to ship.
